Title: Just spotted this interesting little card-title typo...

Messages.Author: Hellion
Messages.Body:
Here's one I haven't seen addressed in the errata lists...
Does Lucia Pacciola (from the Jyhad set) contest
with Luccia Paciola (from the V:TES set)? (Picture, clan,
and skills are identical; Jyhad version says "2 hand
damage", V:TES says "+1 hand damage" for special
ability.)

Elliott

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Hellion wrote:
>
> Here's one I haven't seen addressed in the errata lists...

> Does Lucia Pacciola (from the Jyhad set) contest
> with Luccia Paciola (from the V:TES set)? (Picture, clan,
> and skills are identical; Jyhad version says "2 hand
> damage", V:TES says "+1 hand damage" for special
> ability.)

Yes, just as "Ricki Van Demsy" (Jyhad) contests "Ricki Van Demsi"
(V:TES). And "Eco Terrorists" contests "Ecoterrorists". Etc.

Alternate spellings (a.k.a. Typos :-) are not sufficient to make
the cards distinct.

(Thanks for pointing out the problem, though. :-)
